notes:
Nyxen 1.0 Early Access

The figures look like the chrome pictogram now: broad round shoulders, arms
that hang a little out from the sides, a straight body into two thick legs,
and a round head floating just above - gunmetal chrome with a white shine.
Everyone starts from it once; Look changes it any time, and "Chrome, like the
picture" brings it back. The walk is calmer and the steps match your speed.

New in the Space: reactions (the column on the right, or 1-8) float a heart,
a laugh, fire and more over your head for everyone. A pet follows you - a cat,
a dog, a bunny, a duck, a little dragon or a glow orb (Look). Photo (P) saves
what you see with your screenshots. Invite friends here, in Spaces, sends them
a card that brings them straight to you.

Library: What should I play? picks one of your installed games - leaning
towards ones you nearly finished or have not touched in a while - to play,
roll again, or invite friends to. Almost done and Never played filters, and
play times now come from Steam itself for every game.

Messages: invites to play a Steam game arrive as a card with its art and a
Play button. The assistant's Speak button can be cancelled.
